summary: English and French first-party discovery identified the official Kisantu land/cadastral district in Kongo-Central and the ministry's formal land-register research route. The official public pages do not expose an anonymous parcel ID-plus-geometry service. The BIC public viewer is limited to Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu, so no sample was retained.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: All executed discovery queries, URLs, official page requests, scope checks, schema/CRS checks, safe field allowlist, scope limits, and uncertainty are recorded in city-1675-kisantu.json. No formal request was submitted because it requires identity/documents and is outside anonymous safe research.

custodians.name: Circonscription foncière de Kisantu / Ministère des Affaires Foncières, RDC
custodians.scope: Local land and cadastral custodian for Kisantu in Kongo-Central, directly listed in the official district directory.

custodians.name: Ministère des Affaires Foncières RDC
custodians.scope: National land-affairs authority publishing the official directory and formal registry/cadastre research procedure; no public Kisantu parcel feature endpoint qualified.

safeFieldAllowlist: stable native cadastral parcel identifier only if source-proven
full parcel polygon geometry only when safely returned
scopeLimits: The exact WUP point and population are preserved in the city record.
Official district and procedure evidence is not evidence of publicly downloadable parcel coverage.
No anonymous ID-plus-geometry response, parcel schema, CRS, or citywide vector coverage was qualified.
No owner, address, contact, titleholder, personal, tax/account, certificate, or other unsafe land-record fields were requested or retained.
Packet completion is not source integration/admission.
uncertainty: Kisantu parcel records may exist in local offices or formal-request workflows not exposed anonymously online.
No independent runtime adapter qualification was performed.
